criteria.name: usefulness
criteria.target: Outputs reduce Jackie social/content operations effort without creating extra review burden.

criteria.name: accuracy
criteria.target: Outputs align with current JM1 repo canon and approved public brand standards.

criteria.name: cross_brand_boundary_adherence
criteria.target: No division-specific authority leaks into another division or One-level automation.

criteria.name: hallucination_contamination_rate
criteria.target: Zero material wrong-brand or fabricated claims in lab samples.

criteria.name: microsoft_stack_duplication
criteria.target: Sintra only fills a gap or speed advantage not already covered by Microsoft-first systems.

criteria.name: operational_time_savings
criteria.target: Measurable reduction in drafting, planning, or review time.

criteria.name: action_safety
criteria.target: No public posts, comments, emails, connector changes, or production mutations during lab.

criteria.name: governance_fit
criteria.target: Sintra remains assistive/projection/support and does not become a competing source of record.

adoption_rule: Sintra adoption depends on lab evidence, not novelty.
